_about: All the judgment calls in one place. Change a number here and the tool uses it on the next run.
_metrics_note: Which ratios feed each parameter. 'higher' = higher is better, 'lower' = lower is better.
_thresholds_note: Scores are 0-100%. These are the brief's 3.8 and 2.5 (on a 1-5 scale) converted: (3.8-1)/4 = 70%, (2.5-1)/4 = 37.5%.
_min_data_coverage_note: Share of the weighted score (by parameter weight) that must rest on real data. Below this the call is marked low confidence; the call itself doesn't change.

risk._risk_free_note: Canada 3-month T-bill yield, 2.40% on 2026-10-14 (Trading Economics). Fallback only: with auto_risk_free on, the tool pulls the current yield from the Bank of Canada (series V80691344) each run.

target_price._note: Target = average forward P/E of peers x company's forward EPS. Peer P/Es outside the range below are dropped as outliers.

ai_rationale._note: Optional. Only used with --ai and an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable.
